On their turn, a player flips over two cards. Depending on the pair formed, they can either keep them in their basket, discard them (remove them from the game), or return them to their original positions. But watch out, the beach is full of surprises, and the tide is coming up! The player with the most clams at the end of the tide wins the Golden Clam! Palourde is a fun and fast-paced game for great times with family or friends! Number of players: 2 - 5 Game duration: 5 mn Complexity: 0 / 5 Play Palourde and 1414 other games online. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary The Game: The fishermen take turns flipping two cards of their choice to make them visible to everyone: -If they form a pair (see Pairs), -If an event card is flipped (see Events), -If the cards do not match, they are turned face down and returned to their original positions. The fishing ends when all three “High Tide” cards are revealed. The fisherman with the most clams wins the Golden Clam! The Pairs: Clam + Clam: The fisherman wins the pair and puts the clams in their basket Clam + Rake: The fisherman wins the clam, discards (remove from the game) the rake and plays again. Crab + Crab: The fisherman can steal a clam from a fisherman of his choice. The crabs are then discarded. Shrimp + Shrimp: The fisherman has the right to look at a card secretly. The shrimp are then discarded. Brids + Clam/Crab/Shrimp/Shell: Watch out, the birds eat the clams, crabs, shells, and shrimp! Discard both cards. The Events: If the “Basket Overboard” card is flipped, you overturn your basket! Discard the card as wellas your clams. In your misfortune, you are allowed to play again... (You can choose to play with this card or not in the game option)¨ If the “Storm Warning” card is flipped, beware, the wind rises! Discard the card and shuffle all the cards from the “Beach”! If a “High Tide” card is flipped, it stays face-up on the “Beach” and the turn passes to the next fisherman. [Rating: 10/10] Palourde is a wonderful game! The kids are having so much fun flipping cards and matching clams during low tide, then switching to fish during high tide—it keeps things exciting and fresh. The ocean theme is beautifully done, and the tidal options with a game extension adds a fun twist to the game. Quick to learn, fun to play, and always full of laughter. Highly recommended!
